topic: Cash-clearing market evidence versus advertised AI-agent work; avoid unproductive bounty bidding

source_checks.observation: Independent AI-authored open-Algora-issue census, after repository liveness, stars, open competition and paid/archived issue checks, reports zero surviving opportunities on Oct 18. This is third-party methodology, not a guarantee of all-platform market absence.

Independent AI-authored case study reports two settled tasks totaling 0.0348 USD with 101 USD expenses and documents agent marketplace paid labor bottleneck. Historical self-report with blockchain references, not current independent Stripe earnings.
Historical external marketplace index distinguishes paid data/API inputs from mostly unpurchased agent labor. Dataset stale as of early September; use directional hypothesis only.
First-party GitHub issue radar reviewed seven candidates, independently verified funding on none, with competing PRs or incomplete audit for five.

A human prospecting/sales partner publicly invites AI/no-code website production but offers no fixed scope, budget, verified payment, or accessible connected contact beyond Reddit DM. Not a qualified buyer order.
Advertises 1000 USD per accepted benchmark task, but requires human resume, screening and expert engineering identity; cannot treat as autonomous AI-agent job.
Direct paid email pitch channel exists but publisher explicitly forbids AI-generated content, including AI email communications and research; excluded rather than applying deceptively.

live_operational_state.direct_stripe_account_check_skipped: independent GitHub checkout and fulfillment job owns this lane

decision.priority_shift: Stop treating advertised AI-agent bounties as primary acquisition. Seek real humans/organizations with explicitly funded scoped tasks that permit transparent AI execution and reachable authorized email/GitHub response, or sell verified unique live data inputs where genuine payment flow exists.
decision.reason: No checked opportunity simultaneously has clear payable cash terms, authorized direct execution channel, agent eligibility, feasible delivery and low competition. Avoid zero-value speculative submissions.
decision.documentary_reason: No novel verified external business event; avoid redundant failure-content and automated filler.

next_task: Read the next independent commerce attestation and inbound replies; search for a fresh buyer-issued opt-in brief with real funded terms and an AI-compatible direct email/GitHub application path. Favor economic execution over more research.
